::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr. 20th 1873  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Alexander Turnbull Library, Wellington, New Zealand.Ref: ms-papers-1786-4.
:::

My dear [Mr Archdeacon](people/person_888.qmd)<sup>1</sup>
At last I return all the precious letters you lent me.[^2] I ought to have done so sooner

I have not been able to use many as they went so much on the same ground as the journal letters.

With many thanks
Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^2]: The Rev. John Frederick Lloyd (1810-1875) was a fellow of St John's College, Auckland, 1849-1853, vicar of St Paul's, Auckland, 1853-1865 and archdeacon of Waitemata, 1865-1870. Owing to ill health he returned to England in 1870 where he became rector of Kirk-lreton, Wirksworth. CMY is thanking him for help with her *Life of John Coleridge Patteson*.
